protocol.generator: Three public-prior forward perturbations and four independent gamma-truth reverse-generated prior regimes
protocol.selection: One global entropy setting chosen by maximum worst-regime development gain, then mean gain; no direction-specific tuning
protocol.development_gate: At least .005 global mean gain and no regime mean loss below -.002, no optimizer failures; otherwise retain Ridge .05
comparators: D02 Bayesian fixed settings (formally rejected K01)
protocol.truth: Independently generated path flows only. Never reads public_reference or hidden answers.

numerical_repair_reference.change: Roundoff-bounded residual-reducing Newton step near stationarity; tolerance remains 2e-6
numerical_repair_reference.assessment_status: Same previously inspected simulator seeds; numerical regression, not a new blind test

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights
